policy: Free assets only: Quaternius CC0 models/motion, KayKit CC0 motion, original pose adaptations, Kenney CC0 furniture/particles/contacts, Free Firearm CC0 recordings. Original map geometry and UI sounds; OFL font and MIT Godot. All assets self-hosted. Operator equipment uses asset-specific commercial licenses and original derived meshes; see operator provenance and included notices. Equipment catalog photographs are GPT-generated fictional visuals; generation prompts and provenance are included.
